watches.name: NO NAME Unique
watches.description: NO NAME One of One — 01 / 01 NO NAME was not developed as part of a collection. It was assembled and modified by hand as a single mechanical object, using parts, ideas and technical solutions taken from different Ugolini Meccanica Watches projects and reworked into something that did not exist before. There will be no second version, no alternative color and no repeated production. This configuration exists only once. 01 / 01. Modified mechanics At the heart of the watch is a modified NH35 automatic movement . The seconds hand remains in its traditional central position, while part of the original movement structure has been reworked. A custom-made carbon-fiber plate holds specific gears securely in position. It is not simply a decorative element, but a functional mechanical component created specifically for this unique configuration. The visible carbon plate creates a technical and asymmetric composition, giving the movement an identity that cannot be confused with a conventional automatic watch. Original case The 43 mm case has been preserved in its original form and finish, without any additional hand-working or structural modification. Its proportions give NO NAME a strong presence on the wrist and provide the foundation for its unconventional mechanical configuration. Every component was selected and assembled specifically for this one-of-a-kind watch. Green suede leather NO NAME is completed by a green suede leather strap , selected specifically for this unique configuration. Its soft texture and deep green color contrast with the mechanical appearance of the case. It adds warmth to the composition without reducing the strong and unconventional identity of the watch. Built to be noticed Some watches are designed to disappear quietly under a shirt cuff. This one is not. This is the kind of watch that creates conversation. The kind of object that makes someone look twice and ask: “What is that?” It does not simply show the time. It shows something about the person wearing it. Machines of character Ugolini Meccanica Watches is not made for everyone. We build watches for people with a strong personality . For people who like unusual objects, who are not interested in following everyone else and who want the things they wear to say something about who they are. We do not follow the predictable rules of boring watchmaking. We prefer experimentation, mechanical solutions, unusual proportions and objects with a visible identity. Our watches are not accessories designed to disappear. They are machines of character. One watch. One owner. NO NAME was built only once. When it leaves the workshop, this exact configuration will not be repeated. One object, one owner, one story. 01 / 01.

Automatic mechanics. Italian character. FORZA is back. Its unmistakable design combines a 43 mm carbon-fiber case, a carbon-fiber bezel and dial, and the precision of a NH36 automatic movement. BUILT IN CARBON FIBER The case is CNC machined from a solid block of carbon fiber. Sharp lines and the material's distinctive layered texture give FORZA its bold identity while keeping it light on the wrist. Carbon fiber extends across the case, bezel and dial, creating a coherent design in which the material itself takes center stage. AUTOMATIC MECHANICS Inside FORZA, the SEIKO NH36 automatic mechanical movement brings the watch to life, winding through the natural movement of your wrist. CLARITY, DAY AND NIGHT Sapphire crystal protects the carbon-fiber dial, while Super-LumiNova on the hands and hour markers makes the time readable in low light. The orange seconds hand adds a vivid finishing touch. COMFORT WITH CHARACTER A 24 mm silicone strap complements the 43 mm case, providing a comfortable, secure fit. Steel screws and the crown bearing the new UMW emblem complete the design. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS Model FORZA Case CNC-machined carbon fiber Diameter 43 mm Bezel Carbon fiber Dial Carbon fiber Crystal Sapphire Movement SEIKO NH36 Automatic Luminescence Super-LumiNova Screws Steel Crown New UMW emblem Strap 24 mm silicone Design Developed in Italy STRONG BY NAME. DISTINCTIVE BY CONSTRUCTION. FORZA IS BACK. UGOLINI MECCANICA WATCHES DESIGNED WITH PURPOSE.
